text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The day of the JBC Classic. Can Copano 
Rickey, who started out as the chaser, 
finally stand as an equal alongside the 
two of them...?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What is being tested is the balance of 
power. Only when each gives their absolute 
best can the equal stage of the "Four 
Auspicious Beasts" exist.
